The main takeaway from our work is that
the presence of intranuclear in-clusions and eosinophilic oncocytic cytoplasm should not be considered pathognomonic of thyroid neoplasm when the lesion is juxtaposed adjacent to it.
FNAs and histological examination are essential to differentiate thyroid neoplasms from chordoma, which is a critical step in the management of these patients.
FNAs and histopathology should not be interpreted in isolation and a thorough clinical evaluation is necessary to avoid diagnostic pitfalls.
